The `toArray` method, as documented, can throw two exceptions: `ArrayStoreException` and `NullPointerException`. 
- `ArrayStoreException` is thrown if the runtime type of the specified array is not a supertype of the runtime type of every element in the list. In this case, since the list `propName` is explicitly created to hold `String` elements and the array passed to `toArray` is also of type `String`, this exception cannot be thrown. 
- `NullPointerException` is thrown if the specified array is `null`. In the code snippet, the array passed to `toArray` is created using `new String[propName.size()]`, which is never `null`, thus this exception is also avoided.
